5 تزنّد He was, or became, straitened, or embarrassed, and contracted in his bosom: (A:) he was, or became, straitened, or embarrassed, so as to be unable to reply, or to answer: and he was angry; (A, K;) and was incensed. (TA.) The saying of 'Adee, “إِذَا أَنْتَ فَاكَهْتَ الرِّجَالَ فَلَا تَلَغْ
وَقُلْ مِثْلَ مَا قَالُوا وَلَا تَتَزَنَّدِ
” [When thou jestest with men, be not altogether foolish, but say like as they have said, and be not straitened, &c.,] some relate with ى [in the last word, saying تَتَزَيَّدِ: see art. زيد]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
